primary_sources.title: CDC Clear Communication Index Score Sheet
primary_sources.inspected_locator: PDF pp. 1–3, 5; required audience/objective/message fields; conditional scoring parts
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Communication-design checklist. Four initial fields govern scoring; different translation audiences require separate materials/scoring; Parts B–D are conditional. Where literacy information is absent the sheet permits an average-to-low health-literacy assumption. No score or case demographic inference was made.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Health-communication checklist; no comprehension, accessibility or legal oracle.

primary_sources.title: GOV.UK Consider translations
primary_sources.version_or_release: Live page; no visible release date
primary_sources.inspected_locator: Consider translations, same-page direction, content-type exceptions; extracted text lines 45–53
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Translation policy/user need govern GOV.UK publication. The same-page direction applies within that publishing guidance; fatality notices/statistical data sets have content-type exclusions. It does not prove that all mixed-language web pages fail.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Compatible digital option; paper, SMS and other platforms remain open.

primary_sources.title: WCAG 2.2 fixed Recommendation
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Web content: text resize without assistive technology to 200%, excluding captions/images of text; text rather than images where technology can achieve presentation, except customizable/essential presentation; reflow at 320 CSS-pixel width for vertical scrolling or 256 CSS-pixel height for horizontal scrolling, except parts needing two-dimensional layout. Page default and passage language must be programmatically determinable, with named part-language exceptions.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Proposed narrow checks; selected criteria alone establish neither comprehension nor whole-site conformance/law.

primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.

primary_sources.title: GOV.UK informed consent for user research

primary_sources.title: GOV.UK moderated usability testing
primary_sources.inspected_locator: Planning/tasks, neutral facilitation, dummy data and own assistive technology
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Actual/likely users, believable non-leading goal tasks, consistent guide and access support are explicit. Personal assistive technology is normally preferable; fictional data can be used with contextual limits. No case-specific power calculation supports the sample heuristic.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Formative methods, not representative performance evidence.

primary_sources.title: Toronto recreation registration
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Programs costing more than $100 permit two installments: 50% at registration, remainder by first activity day. Full activities may have a waitlist; an opening brings email, or phone if no account email, with up to 36 hours to accept/decline. Waitlisting does not guarantee enrollment.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: City-specific process example only; no transfer of fees/status or comprehension effectiveness.

primary_sources.title: Austin account creation/registration FAQ
primary_sources.version_or_release: Live page; no visible update date
primary_sources.inspected_locator: FAQ: held spaces; full classes; partial payments
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: No spaces are allocated in advance to the online/walk-in/phone registration routes; all operate live subject to availability. Free waitlisting and an offer-payment deadline are explicit; expiry/decline removes the student from the roster. Deposits apply only to eligible classes. The held-space FAQ is not a blanket denial of post-registration reservations.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: City-specific allocation/payment example. The proposal does not import its policy.

primary_sources.title: RMIT multilingual public-service communication report
primary_sources.version_or_release: Title page June 2023; actual release date not independently established
primary_sources.inspected_locator: PDF pp. 9–15 methods/sample; Table 3 pp. 15–17 and discussion p. 18; pp. 19–23; Appendix IV pp. 52–55
primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Four methods, seven languages and 21 readers. Table 3’s subjective preferences favor Methods 3/4 on A–C, with a D reversal. Sequential exposure, small cells and subjective measures limit inference. Appendix IV elicits main points but supplies no scored objective accuracy or task-completion oracle. Methods describe recruitment intent/sample, not its channel.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Source-bounded implementation lead, not a best translation method for course notices.

primary_sources.observed_operation: Independent official-URL retrieval; read governing extracted context. RMIT Table 3 also inspected in locally rendered PDF pages.
primary_sources.verified_scope_conditions: Official page confirms commissioning/funding context and project dates, separate from the report cover date.
primary_sources.applicability_limit: Administrative frame; not additional outcome validation.

limitations.finding: The final reports numbered RMIT methods without defining all four in the prose. Their definitions remain in the final source map and official report. This weakens stand-alone readability of the comparator, but does not choose a method or change the proposed A/B/C/D study.

locator.heading_or_text: **E10 — Austin Parks and Recreation registration FAQ.**

limitations.finding: The shorthand about spaces not being held across routes should be read as the FAQ’s allocation-by-registration-method rule. It does not establish that submitted/paid places are never held. The final makes no such broader assertion and does not transfer Austin policy.

limitations.category: minor protocol wording, separate from source qualification

locator.heading_or_text: D inputs remain sealed until the exact recipe

limitations.finding: The final plan-disposition cell says no D inputs were accessed in this stage, despite the mapped brief/revealed-plan inputs and its own reading record. Read literally, that blanket sentence is inaccurate. It is not evidence of unauthorized access; it cannot certify release compliance. The scientific scope and original input bytes remain intact.

locator.heading_or_text: As an initial planning heuristic only

limitations.finding: The sample targets are explicitly unvalidated, not powered/representative; budget/language cells and critical-error/endpoint priorities remain to be settled before recruitment. Supported-route changes are descriptive before/after observations and cannot by themselves isolate assistance from practice. No causal assistance effect or population estimate is claimed.

lineage_findings.issue: SC 1.4.4 was omitted from the investigator top-level WCAG locator while zoom was proposed.
lineage_findings.final_status: CORRECTED: final prose/map explicitly add SC 1.4.4, retaining bounded web-only applicability.

lineage_findings.issue: The phrase same-page separation is awkward; the source directs GOV.UK publishers against mixing translated and English text on one page.
lineage_findings.final_status: CLARIFIED: final gives the accurate direction and system scope.

lineage_findings.issue: E11 was added after the concealed plan was released; it is absent from the immutable discovery.
lineage_findings.final_status: DISCLOSED SUPPLEMENT: draft and maps state the post-release addition; final carries it. Do not attribute E11 discovery to the brief-only pre-reveal artifact.

criticism_dispositions.critic: Intended document-specific preference result ENTAILS; generalized-course-notice diagnostic UNDETERMINED; retain original.
criticism_dispositions.final: Accept intended result; reject broader diagnostic as unsupported.
criticism_dispositions.independent: SUPPORTED: Table 3 and discussion support the bounded result. Rejection is refusal to generalize, not a contradiction finding about every other notice.

criticism_dispositions.critic: System-specific presentation option ENTAILS; all-web-systems requirement UNDETERMINED; retain scoped option.
criticism_dispositions.final: Accept scoped option; reject universal default.
criticism_dispositions.independent: SUPPORTED: governing GOV.UK context does not eliminate compatible mixed-language alternatives elsewhere.

criticism_dispositions.critic: Recruitment channel not named in inspected methods ENTAILS; whole-report absence UNDETERMINED.
criticism_dispositions.final: Retain methods-bounded wording and uncertainty about whole-report absence.
criticism_dispositions.independent: SUPPORTED for inspected methods. Neither failed search nor absent mention authenticates a global negative.

criticism_dispositions.critic: Sample targets unsupported as an evidence-derived/powered size; preserve heuristic qualification.
criticism_dispositions.independent: ACCEPT: no demonstrated minimum/power is claimed; final size remains contingent.

criticism_dispositions.critic: Minor WCAG locator omission and images-of-text exceptions.
criticism_dispositions.independent: ACCEPT CORRECTION: exact fixed Recommendation supports it. No failed actual notice check is invented.

criticism_dispositions.critic: Brief/plan completeness met; no material wrong/incomplete claim found.
criticism_dispositions.final: Accept completeness and retain scientific scope.
criticism_dispositions.independent: Independently met, subject to L01–L04. The verdict follows original clauses and primary sources, not critic agreement.

ACCEPT: actual policy, texts, language/audience/access distribution, process history, recruitment resources, local ethics/privacy and endpoint weighting cannot be resolved from fictional inputs. Necessary comparator/method investigation was performed.

method_note: Independent primary retrieval and semantic comparison. Digests establish byte identity only. Original authored evidence was read in full; no science or frozen input was altered.
